symbols.reasoning: Replays RequestId settlement first; rejects negative actual, authorizes base actor/approval, optionally loads driver name. Transaction locks all driver nonterminal deliveries then open custodies, builds facts and rejects nothing-to-settle or active deliveries. Expected equals already Collected, not original responsibility; variance requires reason and stacked approval. Requires active day inside transaction. Positive actual posts one incoming Main movement/journal; zero actual skips monetary journal but still writes settlement/closed operational rows. Marks custody Settled with SettledAmount=Collected, while aggregate actual shortage/overage retained in settlement record; not claiming each custody receives actual cash allocation. Delivery rows Version++; event/history/audit/save/commit together. Different request concurrent same driver should block then find no rows rather than duplicate payout.
